verdict.rationale: Anytype has no documented built-in AI that generates insights or suggestions inside the app. AI can only reach your data through external assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, connected via the official MCP server, the local API, or the Agents skill, which let those tools read, search and modify Objects. Queries and the Graph are rule-based, not AI. Missing for 10: native in-product AI insights or suggestions, any documented insight or suggestion feature even via integrations, and hands-on corroboration.
